sources.name: Unicode CLDR
sources.version: 48.0 (as shipped in ICU 78.3 with Node 22.23.4; plural rules compared with cldr-json main on 2026-11-11)

provenance.notes: Written in this phase from the cited references and re-expressed; the Arabic text is the researcher's own wording and needs a native reviewer. The checks are proposals for the harness, not yet run.

title.ar: سمِّ التقويم الهجري المستخدم ولا تحسب أشهره بقاعدة
title.en: Name the Hijri variant in use; do not compute its months by rule

statement.ar: حدّد أي تقويم هجري تعرضه (أم القرى، المدني الحسابي…) باسمه. أطوال الأشهر تؤخذ من الجدول: لا تفترض تناوب 30 و29 ولا تُجرِ حسابًا على الأيام خارج التحويل إلى الميلادي. ونبّه إلى أن الإعلان الرسمي قد يختلف يومًا.
statement.en: State which Hijri calendar is displayed (Umm al-Qura, tabular civil…) by name. Month lengths come from the table: do not assume alternating 30 and 29, and do no day arithmetic except through conversion to Gregorian. Warn that an official announcement may differ by a day.

rationale.ar: التقاويم الهجرية المختلفة تعطي تواريخ مختلفة لليوم نفسه، وأم القرى جدولي تصدره جهة رسمية وله نطاق سنوات محدود.
rationale.en: Different Hijri calendars give different dates for the same day; Umm al-Qura is a table issued by an authority and covers a limited range of years.

checks: dates cases tagged calendars-differ: the three variants disagree; the UI labels which one is shown.
dates DT-months-1447 and DT-months-1448: the grid shows exactly the listed number of days in each month.
Adding one month to the 30th of a 30-day month lands on a valid day of the next month (29 or 30).
A date outside the table's range is reported as unsupported, not extrapolated silently.
